crm_notes: Account focused on cross-lingual enterprise search for a global consulting client base. Wants high recall across 12 languages (EN, ES, FR, PT, DE, NL, AR, ZH, JA, KO, RU, IT). Current architecture: per-language vector shards + unified metadata index. Primary ask: reduce per-query cost while improving per-language recall precision; latency targets vary by region. Prefers Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC network isolation. Quote from CTO: 'We need sub-300ms end-to-end for EU users and consistent recall across Arabic and Chinese — can't have sharp drops between languages.' SE notes: initial POC used multilingual embedding model (mT-family) but plan to test language-specific encoders for low-resource languages. Internal priority: cost-per-query <= $0.02 at 99th percentile with top-20 rerank.
technical_summary: Scale: ~75M documents, average doc length 1.2k tokens. Query load expected: baseline 20 QPS, peak 60 QPS. Indexing strategy: language-detected ingestion -> per-language vector shards (HNSW/FAISS), per-shard quantization profiles, incremental reindex. Retrieval pipeline: ANN top-100 per shard -> cached top-100 merge -> cross-lingual rerank (mono cross-encoder) on top-20. Caching: Redis TTL for hot-query top-k, KV cache for prefix reuse. Reranker options evaluated: lightweight cross-encoder (monoT5-style) and distilled cross-encoders; tradeoffs measured in latency and tokens/CPU. Fallback: translate-query->single multilingual index for rare languages. Metrics tracked: per-language recall@10/100, precision@10, retrieval latency, rerank latency, cost/token and cost/query.
indexing_scale_notes: Current POC indexed 12M docs (subset) with per-language shards; full run expected to hit 75M. Concern: shard imbalance — Spanish and English are hot, Arabic and Korean are minority but critical. Requested automated shard rebalancer and quantization guidance from Redwood Optimize. Expected index storage ~8-12TB with 8-bit quantization profiles. Document: drive:/results/index_size_estimate_20260201.pdf
per_language_targets: Arabic/Russian: recall@10 >= 0.68 after language-specific fine-tune, p95 <= 420ms
cost_expectations: Target blended cost per query $0.012-$0.020 (includes retrieval + rerank); open to Dedicated pricing with committed throughput to hit target. Wants modeling of cost with different rerank top-K values (K=5,10,20).
poC_details: POC phases: 1) ingest 12M subset, validate per-language recall, 2) perf sweep (72h) on Dedicated pool, 3) run reranker ablation and cost modeling, 4) sign pilot. POC owners: Product exec (Elena Park), Eng lead (Marcus Li).
